models: Tüm VAG Grubu Modeller (Audi, VW, Seat, Skoda, Porsche)
engines: Tüm VAG Benzinli (TSI/TFSI) ve Dizel (TDI) Motorlar
symptoms: Fault Code can not be erased
technicalNotes:
When found in VW Touran (1T): Auxiliary Heating (or similar), perform Line Filling.
Set Adaptasyon / Kalibrasyon Yapın:  Channel 030 to a New Value of 30.
Set Adaptasyon / Kalibrasyon Yapın:  Channel 043 to a New Value of 0.
Perform Basic Setting in Measuring Value Block (MVB) 066.
